node.title: The sharp rate-half FPC5 guarded locator flat has no common gcd
node.statement: For the official sharp rate-half M=4,t=2 guarded cofactor kernel, the entire locator image V_F has maximal common gcd one. The two cofactor pairs (L_0,0) and (0,L_0) force every common divisor into L_0; for each root of L_0, interpolation with A_1=1 produces a kernel member whose locator is nonzero there. Thus the sharp descriptor is already gcd-trivial. This does not discharge the candidate-wise primitive condition gcd(F,W_F)=1 or count split points.
